name: HB-2 LFS repo-port smoke
purpose: Port the official LLM-First-Search control loop onto the shared HB-2 budget/scoring substrate and run a minimal sudoku+graph_color smoke. This establishes a repo-grounded LFS runner with LLM child-value evaluation, LLM explore decisions, one token counter, and official Reasoning Gym scoring, but it is not a final HB-2 comparison.

provenance.spec: user CODING SPEC — HB-2 External No-Train Matched-Budget Comparison (consolidated, v1)

code_added_used.change: Adds a BudgetRunner-style LFS adapter using frontier nodes, LLM child-value evaluation, LLM explore/continue decisions, shared token billing, and official dataset.score_answer scoring.

commands.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ~/.local/bin/uv run --python .venv/bin/python python -m analysis.kvcache_lfs_baseline --output results/kvcache_matched_budget_v0/hb2_lfs/item126_lfs_smoke_sudoku_graph_n1.json --checkpoint-path results/kvcache_matched_budget_v0/hb2_lfs/item126_lfs_smoke_sudoku_graph_n1_checkpoint.json --tasks sudoku,graph_color --n-instances 1 --scan-limit 20 --budget-anchors sudoku:28070,graph_color:32895 --max-expansions 4 --max-new-tokens 96 --dtype fp32 --device cuda
commands.purpose: Run B*-only LFS smoke on one sudoku and one graph_color instance.

headline.sudoku: n=1 smoke at B*=28070 ran 4 expansions, used 1293 tokens, reached depth 2, solve=0/1, status=EXPANSION_CAP.
headline.graph_color: n=1 smoke at B*=32895 ran 4 expansions, used 1261 tokens, reached depth 2, solve=0/1, status=EXPANSION_CAP.
headline.parser: Robust JSON-object scanning reduced state-echo parse failures; each row retained parse_fails=1 for honesty.
headline.single_next_move: Inspect llm-reasoners ToT/RAP examples and port the same BudgetRunner interface before scaling any external baseline.

gate_outcomes.number: Each LLM child-value/explore query bills input plus generated tokens and stops before exceeding budget_B.
Sudoku uses dataset.score_answer(render_answer(...)); graph_color uses official bounded-register score adapter.
n=1 expansion-capped smoke only; futoshiki, full grids, ToT, RAP, and First Finish are not complete.

decision.next_step_routing: Port ToT and RAP from maitrix-org/llm-reasoners into the same shared budget/scoring substrate, then decide external baseline scaling order.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not complete HB-2 and does not show LFS competitiveness. It only validates that a repo-grounded LFS adapter compiles, runs, bills tokens, and reaches official scoring paths on two tasks.
honesty.scope_limit: n=1, B*-only, sudoku+graph_color only, and max_expansions=4. Futoshiki and budget curves are omitted.
honesty.implementation_limit: The original LFS task-specific prompts and datasets are adapted to this repo's CSP/graph_color substrate; the adapter preserves the PathNode/frontier, child-value, and explore-decision control pattern but is not a vendored execution of the upstream code.
honesty.external_limit: ToT, RAP, and optional First Finish are still not ported/run. Beyond-the-Frontier remains final-not-run because no official repo was found.
